description: A multi-line Shopify order arrives for a new customer. The agent must create the HubSpot contact, tag it with every purchased SKU, and add one fulfillment-queue entry per line item.
user_message: New Shopify order webhook: order #SHOP-15540 from theo.mensah@example.com. Line items: SKU 'CAM-12-PRO' qty 1, SKU 'TRIPOD-STD' qty 2. Total $412.00. Process for fulfillment.

context.system_prompt: You are a CRM order-fulfillment agent. Check for an existing HubSpot contact before creating one. Tag the contact with every purchased SKU. Add one fulfillment-queue entry per distinct line item, each with its own SKU and quantity. Do not invent shipping or payment actions.

acceptable_responses: Confirms the contact was created, tagged with both CAM-12-PRO and TRIPOD-STD, and that both line items were queued for fulfillment with the correct quantities.

forbidden_claims: A line item, SKU, or quantity not present in the order
A shipping confirmation or tracking number

policy_rules: Tag the contact with every purchased SKU.
Queue one entry per distinct line item with its own quantity.
forbidden_actions: Collapsing the two line items into a single fulfillment-queue entry.
Creating a duplicate contact for the same email.

provenance.author: Wajid Ahmad
provenance.notes: Multi-line-item expansion of task_001; tests per-line-item fan-out without collapsing quantities.
